display.purpose: Names, headings, narrative moments. Never buttons, labels, or data values.

body.purpose: Everything functional: facts, instructions, UI chrome, form values.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Light ambient lift for pills, chips on hover, hover-preview cards.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Stronger elevation for full sheets and anything that should read as clearly above the interface.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Bouncy — arrivals, confirmations, attention moments (sheet-up, card-in, button press-release).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Smooth, non-bouncy — simple state transitions, shakes, fades.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width or flexed footer action button (e.g. Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #c2603a; color: #fffdf9; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), filter 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c2603a; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #f2f3f5; color: #1c1d21; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), filter 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-btn-neutral:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Icon Pill
components.description: Topbar circular icon button (search, notifications, filters).
components.html: <button class="ds-pill" aria-label="Search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-pill { height: 38px; min-width: 38px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ebedf0; color: #1c1d21; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,28,0.04), 0 6px 20px rgba(20,22,28,0.07); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background: #f2f3f5; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c2603a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip (unselected / selected)
components.description: Relationship-type or filter chip, e.g. in Add Relative or search filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f2f3f5; color: #1c1d21; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,28,0.04), 0 6px 20px rgba(20,22,28,0.07); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-chip--on { background: #c2603a; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(194,96,58,0.28); }

components.name: Text Field (default / error)
components.description: Standard labeled text input, with the invalid/error state.
components.html: Enter a valid email address
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; height: 50px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #ebedf0; background: #fff; padding: 0 15px; font-size: 16px; color: #1c1d21; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c2603a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(194,96,58,0.14); } .ds-field--err { border-color: #f5b7b1; background: #fef2f2; } .ds-field-err { font-size: 12px; color: #c0392b; margin-top: 6px; }

narrative.northStar: Warm, editorial, human — heirloom photo album meets a living interface.
narrative.overview: Bloodline reads as a physical, cared-for object (paper, ink, a warm accent, generous type) that happens to move and breathe, rather than as software chrome. It is deliberately not enterprise SaaS, not a dashboard, and not a research database with a UI bolted on. Distinctiveness is spent deliberately, not evenly: the tree visualizations and the Keepsake are where the product is allowed to be bold; forms, settings, and management surfaces stay calm and unshowy by comparison.
keyCharacteristics: One warm terracotta accent against a near-white paper ground; a quiet sage companion; a small, sparingly-used supporting cast (gold, memorial violet)
Fraunces (serif) for headings and emotionally-weighted moments; Hanken Grotesk (sans) for everything functional
Pill shapes (999px) for small tappable controls; soft 12-16px radii for panels/fields/buttons; 24px for full sheets
Spring-eased arrivals and confirmations; quieter ease for simple state changes; reduced-motion respected everywhere
Flat by default; a soft ambient shadow only on things genuinely floating above the page

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only color that means primary action or active state. Sage, gold, and memorial violet each have one narrow job and are never substituted for the primary accent's role.

rules.name: The No Dark Mode Rule
rules.body: Every color is a hardcoded hex value and color-scheme is forced to light only, on purpose (iOS Safari must not invert these colors). Never add a prefers-color-scheme: dark branch without revisiting this decision explicitly.

rules.name: The Error-Is-Not-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: A dedicated error palette exists for validation/destructive-action states, but the Keepsake deliberately avoids red in favor of a desaturated ink-gray to preserve its editorial tone. Follow whichever convention the surface already uses.

rules.name: The Serif-Means-Someone Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for names, headings, and narrative — never for buttons, labels, or numeric/tabular content.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means this is physically above the surface right now (a sheet, a floating nameplate, a hover card). Never apply it to a resting, in-flow element just to add visual weight.

dos: Do keep terracotta as the only color meaning primary/active
Do use Fraunces only for names, headings, and narrative
Do default to pill radius for small tappable controls
Do use a shadow only on something genuinely floating above the page
Do spring-ease arrivals and confirmations; use plain ease for simple transitions; respect prefers-reduced-motion
Do match the nearest existing sibling's font-size/spacing value rather than inventing a new round number
donts: Don't introduce a generic .card grid/dashboard layout — none exists in this codebase on purpose
Don't add a second, unrelated brand color for variety
Don't simplify the bespoke tree visualizations (organic/Bubble, Chart, Canopy, Atlas) or the Keepsake into ordinary DOM component patterns
Don't add dark-mode support or a prefers-color-scheme branch
Don't treat the internal ?lab= motion/layout experimentation harnesses as shipped UI needing design polish
